description: Look up the lease predicates doc_verify_facts and doc_abstract_lease know (lease.expiration_date, lease.base_rent_schedule, lease.go_dark, ...) before extracting: for each, its value shape as JSON Schema, one valid example with a quote that states it (and whether that example verifies), which parts of the value are checked against the quote and how (number, ratio, date, verbatim name, as-written words, a worded enum, a number inside free text), which count as checked only when the quote writes them out (summaries, some enums), and which always need review (true/false values and enums no wording confirms, such as a CAM cap method or a kick-out party) unless a person confirms them. Generated from the same tables the checks use. Give predicate for one, prefix (e.g. lease.renewal) for a group, or neither for all. Also returns notes on statuses, paths, human confirmation and the generic rules for any other dotted predicate. Reads no document.

predicate.description: One predicate to describe, e.g. lease.go_dark. Omit both predicate and prefix for every lease predicate.

prefix.description: Only predicates starting with this, e.g. "lease.renewal" or "lease.". Give predicate or prefix, not both.

name: doc_predicates
title: Lease predicate catalog
